name: Mayumi
source:
A Japanese high-school student receives a letter from his sweetheart Mayumi, who has gone to study in a remote school as an exchange student. Something in the tone of the letter convinces the young man that Mayumi might be a trouble. He travels to her school, only to discover that Mayumi was kidnapped. Now it is up to him to investigate the school premises, talk to the personnel and other students, and rescue his beloved one.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mayumi]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
一名日本高中生收到恋人真由美寄来的信。真由美作为交换生，正在一所偏远的学校留学。信中的语气让年轻人确信她可能遇上了麻烦。他赶到真由美的学校，却发现她已经遭人绑架。为了救出心爱的人，他必须调查校园、询问教职员工和其他学生，查明事情的真相。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mayumi]Moby Games[/url]]
